newsitem.title: USA: Scripps to buy Harte-Hanks media - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Scripps to buy Harte-Hanks media - WSJ.

text.p: E.W. Scripps Co has agreed to acquire the media assets of Harte-Hanks Communications Inc for between $625 million and $775 million, the Wall Street Journal said on Monday.
In its electronic edition, the Journal said the assets being sold are six daily newspapers, a group of weekly publications and a television and radio station affiliated with the CBS network.
The price tag depends on the outcome of recent tax legislation, the Journal said. An announcement was expected to be made on Monday on the deal.
The move would focus Harte-Hanks on its direct-marketing business. In March, the company said it had hired Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp to find a buyer for its media assets.
